blocks.task_summary: Find the time q when the particle first comes to rest by differentiating the displacement function and setting velocity to zero.
method_path: solve for smallest positive t in [0, 10] using GDC

evidence.basis: recognizing at rest when ds/dt = 0 OR s is a minimum (M1); q = 5.73553... = 5.74 A1; Note: If no working shown, award (M1)A0 for 5.7 (2sf).

blocks.task_summary: Find the total distance travelled in the first q seconds by integrating the absolute value of velocity or using the difference between initial and minimum displacement.
method_path: set up definite integral of |v(t)| from 0 to q
accepted_alternatives: Use displacement difference: compute s(0) and s(q) where s(q) is minimum, then total distance = s(0) − s(q).

evidence.basis: METHOD 1: recognizing that integral of v(t) is required (M1); integral setup (A1); 7.68302... = 7.68 (m) A1.

METHOD 2: recognition that total distance travelled is the difference between the initial displacement and the displacement at minimum (M1); initial displacement is 3.38302... AND at minimum is −4.3 (A1); 7.68302... = 7.68 (m) A1.
